rows.name: This lamp... It has a very strange glow.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
It's a remnant of the High Entia.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

They've hidden themselves away in the upper reaches now,[XENO:n ]
but at one time they controlled this whole area.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
It's the perfect place to get some shut eye.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]The lamp'll keep the monsters away.[XENO:n ]
We'll be safe if we rest here.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
